verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents shared drives, which are network storage reachable from multiple machines on a private network, and Notebooks come with shared persistent storage for long-term development. Together these show storage that is decoupled from any single compute instance, which is the core of the story. The machine-level persistent disk (resizable up to 2 TB) supports this but is tied to one VM. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that shared drives survive machine deletion, docs on attaching or mounting and on dataset/checkpoint workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.
